messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] 2026-11-02T16:14:48Z — Increased 5xx/latency observed from eu-west prefix-cache ring impacting hosted text generation endpoints. Fallback to uncached exec automatically enabled. Incident: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1829998888 :warning:

Rhea (oncall): Investigating now. Grafana shows a step increase in cache miss latency and backing-store IO spikes starting ~16:12Z. Looks like a sudden surge of small writes causing fragmentation.

Mateo (eng-sre): Logs show repeated "fragment_alloc_fail" and a handful of worker panics in cache-shard-12. Snippet:
```
[16:12:33] cache.shard-12: fragment_alloc_fail count=47
[16:12:36] cache.shard-12: worker panic: arena_corrupt
```

Anya (support): Drafting a short customer note for affected tenants: "We've detected elevated errors and latency in our eu-west cache tier affecting some workloads. We enabled a fallback path; requests continue to succeed but may be slower. We're actively mitigating and will update." Will send to priority customers now.

Darin (infra): Rolling restart targeted at shard-12 pool to reclaim fragmented memory and bumping async IO workers to reduce queueing. Provisioning two extra cache instances as hot spares. ETA ~5m. Collecting core dumps and disk traces to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1829998888/

Clara (product): Confirm whether Dedicated/private deployments are impacted so messaging is clear.

Rhea (oncall): Dedicated/private unaffected; issue limited to multi-tenant eu-west prefix-cache ring. Fallback preserves correctness.

ops-bot: Update 16:19Z — restarts in progress, extra instances added. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv-cache/eu-west?orgId=1

Mateo (eng-sre): Error rate falling from 3.8% -> 0.6% after restarts. Still seeing occasional fragmentation alerts on one host; isolating and draining that host now.

Anya (support): Sent customer note and updated status page. Escalated to account teams for high-traffic customers.

Darin (infra): Drained problematic host; all remaining nodes reporting healthy metrics. Running a short defrag pass and heap verify.

Rhea (oncall): Postmortem owners: Mateo, Darin. Closing criteria: sustained error rate <0.2% and tail latency within 20ms of baseline for 10 minutes. Next update in 10 minutes or on state change.

ops-bot: Update 16:27Z — error rate 0.09% over last 10m, tail latency returned to baseline. Final: fallbacks worked, no data loss, customers notified. :white_check_mark:
